_readme: LACCD class schedule search, probe 2 (S736). Probe 1 (run 45867183517) found no subject dropdown: the search takes the subject as text beside a 'select subject' lookup, and Sam's address (subj=OLD ADL, catalogid=029CE, Campus=LAPC) opens the results, which print 'Course Subject: Older Adults'. This probe asks: does a subject alone (no course number) open results, with or without a campus; what a code with no section prints; whether the 'select subject' lookup lists every subject in one page; and whether a class's detail page (one extra load) prints the course description. Reads only; no model call.

questions.subjects: The subject title the results print for a code.
questions.lookup: Whether the select subject lookup lists every code with its title.
questions.descriptions: Whether a class's detail prints the course description.
